name: Fonio, raw
source: USDA FoodData Central, Foundation Foods, 'Fonio, grain, dry, raw' (FDC 2710829)
note: checked 28 Nov against FDC itself (fdc.nal.usda.gov/portal-data/external/2710829): water 9.37, protein 7.17, fat 1.69, carbohydrate by difference 81.3, fibre 2.2, energy 377 kcal (Atwater specific; 369 general)

name: Fufu flour, instant
source: Open Food Facts, Heritage Afrika Instant Plantain Fufu Flour 700 g (label)
note: dry flour before mixing with water; like most UK/EU instant fufu it is mainly potato granules with cassava and some plantain

name: Bambara groundnut, dried
source: Yao et al. 2015, Int J Mol Sci 16(9):21428, Bambara groundnut Ci12 seeds, g/100 g fresh weight
note: carbohydrate is starch 50.2 + sugars 2.4 (available); fibre 10.3 g; moisture 11.7%; energy not reported, worked out 4/9/4 plus 2 kcal/g fibre

name: Ogbono, ground
source: Bamidele, Ojedokun & Fasogbon 2015, Food Sci Nutr 3(4):313, 100% dika nut (ogbono) powder
note: non-defatted kernel powder; moisture 6.2%, crude fibre 1.5%, carbohydrate by difference; energy not reported, worked out 4/9/4 plus 2 kcal/g fibre

name: Iru, dried
source: Ogunyinka et al. 2016, Food Sci Nutr 5(1):139, fermented Parkia biglobosa seed (Table 1)
note: fermented seed at 7.3% moisture (dried iru); fibre 9.5%; the paper's '470.5 kJ' energy is inconsistent with its own proximates, so energy worked out 4/9/4 plus 2 kcal/g fibre; wet iru sold in markets is lighter per gram

name: Garden egg, raw
source: Chinedu et al. 2011, Res J Chem Sci 1(3), 'Proximate and phytochemical analyses of Solanum aethiopicum L. and Solanum macrocarpon L. fruits', fresh fruit per 100 g, as tabulated (Table 1, fruit column) in the 2024 Nutrients review PMC11644213
note: moisture 89.3 g, crude fibre 3.0 g, carbohydrate by difference; energy not reported, worked out 4/9/4 plus 2 kcal/g fibre; original PDF (core.ac.uk/download/12356262.pdf) blocks fetches; checked 28 Nov against the review's Table 1: moisture 89.27, protein 2.24, fat 0.52, fibre 2.96, ash 0.87, carbohydrate 4.14

name: Tiger nuts, dried
source: KoRo shaved tiger nuts 1 kg, manufacturer nutrition table (100% tiger nuts)
note: fibre 12 g, sugars 18 g; dried tubers as sold

name: Malt drink, Maltina
source: Open Food Facts, Maltina 33 cl (label), per 100 ml
note: per 100 ml; water, sucrose, sorghum, malted barley, caramel

name: Grains of Selim, dried
source: Fategbe, Avwioroko & Ibukun 2021, Prev Nutr Food Sci 26(2):219, Xylopia aethiopica whole fruit
note: paper's ash+fibre+fat+protein+carbohydrate add to 100% without the 11.33% moisture, so read as dry matter and scaled to as sold (x0.887); fibre 16.3 g; energy worked out 4/9/4 plus 2 kcal/g fibre; other studies report lower fat (10-22%), so this is the high end; used by the gram
